title: Expectation on a sign cube by coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb{R}$. The uniform mean of $f$ on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube equals the mean, over uniform $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ and an independent uniform sign $a\in\{-1,1\}$, of $f$ evaluated at the vector obtained by appending $a$ to $x$.
